I don’t have an FRT or a trigger kicker but my 10.5 PSA upper stove piped a few times (possibly the ammo) so I switched to a toolcraft full auto BCG with an Kaw Valley H3 tungsten buffer and a Kaw Valley XP AR pistol spring and haven’t had any problems since the switch. 
Overall inexpensive upgrade.
Could work for your 7.5”.
